title.purpose: Captions under project and lab frames.

label.purpose: Desktop nav links, set in Product Sans.

motion.name: ease-stage
motion.purpose: Headline rise, preloader, mobile menu slide, hamburger.

motion.name: ease-frame
motion.purpose: Media zoom, button inversion, link underline, portrait entrance.

motion.name: duration-rise
motion.purpose: Headline line reveal, staggered about 0.2s per line.

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Square outlined button that floods black on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { font: 400 1.2em 'Poppins', sans-serif; color: #000; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #000; border-radius: 0; padding: 1em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.645, 0.045, 0.355, 1), color 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.645, 0.045, 0.355, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #000; color: #fff; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #000; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Media Frame
components.description: Project or lab tile: clipped 1px frame whose media zooms on hover, caption below.
components.html: Cat Space Shop Website Design
components.css: .ds-frame-link { display: block; width: 320px; color: #000; text-decoration: none; } .ds-frame { border: 1px solid #000; height: 220px; overflow: hidden; background: #000; } .ds-frame-media { width: 100%; height: 100%; background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, #151515 0 12px, #2b2b2b 12px 24px); transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.645, 0.045, 0.355, 1); } .ds-frame-link:hover .ds-frame-media, .ds-frame-link:focus-visible .ds-frame-media { transform: scale(1.125); } .ds-frame-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #000; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-frame-caption { font: 500 1.25rem 'Poppins', sans-serif; text-align: center; margin: 20px 0 0; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Desktop nav with an underline that draws left to right on hover.
components.html: HomeLabProjectAbout me
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 2em; } .ds-nav a { color: #000; text-decoration: none; font: larger productsans, 'Product Sans', sans-serif; padding-bottom: 4px; background: linear-gradient(currentColor 0 0) bottom left / var(--u, 0%) 0.1em no-repeat; transition: background-size 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.645, 0.045, 0.355, 1); } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a:focus-visible { --u: 100%; background-size: 100% 0.1em; outline: none; }

components.name: Rising Headline
components.description: One-word page title that slides up out of an overflow mask.
components.css: .ds-rise { overflow: hidden; text-align: center; } .ds-rise h1 { font: 700 72px/1.2 'Poppins', sans-serif; color: #000; margin: 0; transform: translateY(100%); animation: ds-moveup 0.4s cubic-bezier(.615, .19, .305, .91) forwards 0.3s; } @keyframes ds-moveup { to { transform: translateY(0); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-rise h1 { animation: none; transform: none; } }

components.name: Preloader Curtain
components.description: Black curtain with the YM. monogram sweeping across before the page reveals.
components.css: .ds-preloader { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 320px; height: 160px; background: #000; overflow: hidden; } .ds-preloader span { color: #fff; font: 700 48px 'Poppins', sans-serif; animation: ds-preload 5s cubic-bezier(.615, .19, .305, .91) infinite; } .ds-preloader span:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0.4s; } .ds-preloader span:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.2s; } @keyframes ds-preload { 0% { transform: translateX(-1000%); } 40% { transform: translateX(0); } 80% { transform: translateX(200%); } 100% { transform: translateX(1000%); } }

components.name: Difference Cursor
components.description: Hollow ring that inverts whatever it passes over. Desktop only.
components.css: .ds-cursor-stage { position: relative; width: 320px; height: 120px; background: #fff; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-cursor-word { font: 700 44px 'Poppins', sans-serif; color: #000; } .ds-cursor { position: absolute; left: 58%; top: 50%; width: 50px; height: 50px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid #fff; mix-blend-mode: difference; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); pointer-events: none; transition: left 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.165, 0.84, 0.44, 1); } .ds-cursor-stage:hover .ds-cursor { left: 40%; }

narrative.overview:
The site is a bare white stage lit in black. Every page opens the same way: a black curtain carrying the "YM." monogram lifts away, and then oversized Poppins headlines rise into view from behind a mask, one line after another, like actors stepping up through a trap door. Nothing on the stage is coloured. The work itself, shown as looping videos and screenshots inside thin black frames, supplies the only colour on the page.

The mood is clean, editorial, and confident. Type is huge and set tight, sections are announced with a single centred word, and there is a lot of empty white around everything. Personality comes from motion rather than ornament: a hollow ring cursor that inverts whatever it passes over, frames that zoom their media on hover, and outlined controls that flood solid black when touched.

This record captures the system as it stands before the planned Vite migration and redesign. Treat it as the incumbent reference, not a mandate for the next world.
keyCharacteristics: Pure black and white. Colour only enters through project media.
Oversized bold type that animates up from an overflow mask.
Square corners and 1px black outlines. No shadows anywhere.
Hover means inversion: outline becomes fill, white becomes black.
`mix-blend-mode: difference` on the logo, hamburger, and cursor so they read over any background.

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Interface chrome uses only Ink Black and Paper White. A third colour in UI is a defect. Colour belongs to the work being shown.

rules.name: The Difference Rule
rules.body: Elements that float above content, the logo, hamburger lines, and cursor, use `mix-blend-mode: difference` so they invert against whatever is beneath instead of carrying their own background.

rules.name: The Rising Line Rule
rules.body: Headlines never fade or pop in. Each line sits inside an `overflow: hidden` wrapper and slides up from `translateY(100%)` to 0 over 0.4s, staggered by about 0.2s per line.

rules.name: The One Word Rule
rules.body: A page title is a single short word or phrase at headline size, centred. Explanatory copy never sits at headline scale.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: Do not add `box-shadow` or `drop-shadow`. If something needs to stand out, invert it or frame it with a 1px line.

dos: Do keep interface colour to Ink Black and Paper White, and let project media carry all colour.
Do reveal headlines line by line from an overflow mask with `cubic-bezier(.615, .19, .305, .91)` over 0.4s.
Do frame every piece of work in a square, 1px black outlined, clipped frame with a centred caption beneath.
Do express hover as inversion or as a 1.125 media zoom.
Do use `mix-blend-mode: difference` for chrome that floats over content.
donts: Don't add rounded corners to frames or buttons.
Don't add shadows, tinted surfaces, or decorative gradients to the interface.
Don't introduce a fourth typeface. Poppins, Prompt, and Product Sans already cover display, body, and nav.
Don't fade headlines in. They rise.
